retrievalProfile.description: A dual-panel layout featuring a close-up portrait in the top half and an action-oriented medium shot in the bottom half, separated by a clean white horizontal band containing the title.

recipe.visualDefinition: A two-part vertical composition where the top section features a warm, shallow-depth-of-field portrait and the bottom section shows a dynamic, motion-blurred figure, anchored by a central white horizontal strip for typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Top-bottom split separated by a white gutter
Contrast between static portrait and dynamic action
Warm, sun-drenched color palette across both frames
Typography centered within the white horizontal divider
coreInvariants: Horizontal white band separating two distinct photographic zones

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Top frame features a large-scale facial close-up offset to the right; bottom frame features a centered figure with arms outstretched.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central white horizontal band containing the red serif title.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top-right face, move down to the central text, and finish on the bottom figure's expressive pose.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is densely packed with photographic content, using the white band as the primary relief.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm earth tones (browns, greens, and skin tones) in the photography.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pure white for the central divider band.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Deep crimson red for the primary display typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the warm spectrum with soft, diffused lighting.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid cool blues or neon colors

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Classical serif with high stroke contrast
letterConstructionRules: Large initial capital letter with a descending swash
Tight tracking for the main title
characterSpecificRedesigns: The first letter is significantly larger and drops below the baseline of the other letters
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast serif for the title paired with a clean, wide-tracked sans-serif for secondary information.

avoid: Centering the text vertically across the images

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the cinematic serif feel and classical proportions.
Suitable for the wide-tracked secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a split-frame image. The top half is a warm-toned close-up of a smiling man's face. The bottom half is a motion-blurred shot of a man with arms raised in a forest. Leave a solid white horizontal band across the middle.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place a large red serif title in the white band, ensuring the first letter is oversized. Add smaller sans-serif metadata text above and below the title.

verificationChecks: Is there a clear white horizontal divider?
Is the first letter of the title larger than the rest?
Are the two photographic sections distinct in subject and motion?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the motion blur in the bottom frame
mustRedesign: Do not use specific actor likenesses
Do not use existing movie logos

mustAchieve: Clean typographic alignment within the white band
Consistent warm color grading across both photos
Legible hierarchy between title and metadata

postGenerationChecks: Check that the white band is perfectly horizontal
Ensure the red text has a subtle drop shadow for depth
Verify the bottom image has visible motion blur
Confirm the top image is a sharp, warm-toned portrait
recipe.reuseFormula: Split-frame photography + central white typographic gutter + high-contrast serif title.
